interpretation.scope: main and disposable checkpoint exposures remain separate; single-run diagnostics do not establish task learning or isolate a cause of failure
interpretation.status: status field including its framing EOS; disjoint from raw_content and other eos
interpretation.task_outcomes: use the authenticated corrected audit for task success, migration, retention and repair; no grading replay
